name: Flush DNS Cache
description: Clears and resets the contents of the DNS client resolver cache.

name: Show TCP Listening Ports
command: Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen | Select-Object LocalAddress, LocalPort, OwningProcess, @{Name='Process';Expression={(Get-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).ProcessName}} | Sort-Object LocalPort
description: Lists all active listening TCP ports along with process names and PIDs.

name: Full IP Configuration
description: Displays detailed network configuration for all network adapters.

name: Reset Winsock Catalog
description: Resets the Windows Socket API catalog to clean state (reboot recommended).

name: System File Checker (SFC)
description: Scans integrity of all protected system files and repairs damaged files.

name: DISM Component Store Health Check
description: Scans Windows image for component store corruption without repairing.

name: Clean Windows Temp Files
command: Remove-Item -Path $env:TEMP\* -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item -Path 'C:\Windows\Temp\*' -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Output 'Temp files cleaned successfully.'
description: Safely clears temporary files from user and Windows system temp folders.

name: Restart Print Spooler
description: Restarts the Windows Print Spooler service to clear stuck print jobs.

name: Restart Windows Update Service
command: Stop-Service -Name wuauserv -Force; Start-Service -Name wuauserv; Get-Service -Name wuauserv
description: Restarts the Windows Update (wuauserv) background service.

name: Shutdown WSL Instances
command: wsl --shutdown; Write-Output 'WSL virtual machine instances cleanly shut down.'
description: Terminates all running Windows Subsystem for Linux distributions.

name: Developer Environment Version Check
command: Write-Output '=== Installed Tools ==='; if (Get-Command node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { node -v | ForEach-Object { "Node.js: $_" } }; if (Get-Command npm -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { npm -v | ForEach-Object { "npm: $_" } }; if (Get-Command python -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { python --version }; if (Get-Command git -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { git --version }; if (Get-Command rustc -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { rustc --version }; if (Get-Command docker -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { docker --version }
description: Displays version info for Node.js, npm, Python, Git, Rust, and Docker.

name: Check Docker Desktop Service
description: Checks status of Docker Desktop Windows backend services.
